title: Stabilize prefix/suffix tokenizer handling and publish model compatibility flags during onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: During model onboarding we've seen intermittent token count drift and chat-template mismatches across model variants. Root causes include: inconsistent handling of leading/trailing whitespace and role delimiters across tokenizer versions, model package rollouts that don't pin tokenizer compatibility metadata, and downstream performance-profile calculators that use raw token counts without accounting for tokenizer normalization. This ticket stabilizes tokenizer prefix/suffix handling (explicit normalization rules), adds model metadata fields to pin tokenizer compatibility and tokenization-version, and ensures the onboarding pipeline publishes a compatibility flag and adjusted performance profile when tokenizer behavior changes.

Goals: 1) Define and implement deterministic prefix/suffix normalization rules used at onboarding time (trim vs preserve policy, canonical role delimiter mapping). 2) Surface a new model metadata field tokenization_version and compatibility_tier so runtime routing and the Console can make safe fallbacks. 3) Update performance profile publisher to recalc nominal token counts when tokenization_version differs from the canonical baseline and annotate published profiles with the normalization delta. 4) Add automated golden-sample tokenization tests to the onboarding CI and a smoke check in the runtime that warns when observed token counts exceed published deltas.

Non-goals: We do not plan to refactor tokenizer internals or replace tokenizers. This ticket focuses on normalization, metadata, testing, and publish-time adjustments so rollouts remain safe and observable.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic prefix/suffix normalization policy is documented and committed in the onboarding spec (Confluence)
Model package must include tokenization_version string and compatibility_tier in metadata; onboarding rejects packages lacking these fields
Performance profile publisher recalculates token metrics when tokenization_version != baseline and adds token_count_delta to profile payloads
Onboarding CI runs golden tokenization_vector tests for 12 canonical prompts and fails on >2 regressions
Runtime emits a warning metric (tokenization_delta_warn) when live token counts exceed published token_count_delta by configured margin
